profile.headline: Just a Rusty, C++ rated SW Engineer 🙃

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and reviewed Rust code for cryptographic algorithms from existing C++ source code.
• Led a small team of SW engineers by breaking down an algorithm into smaller components and worked with the team to put the pieces together for integration.
• Interviewed candidates and mentored new hires in Rust Programming Language.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering · Rust (Programming Language) · Software Development · Interviewing · Cryptography · Regression Testing · Testing · Debg · Integration Testing · Functional Verification

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Scripted in-house development language to test and verify software against low-level requirements.
• Created Python and MATLAB scripts to analyze data obtained in the lab.
• Produced test procedures.
• Applied agile methodology to facilitate SW verification and debugging and update test procedures with weekly regression testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Scripting · Python (Programming Language) · Programming · Testing · Global Positioning System (GPS)

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Routed wire harnesses with CATIA Electrical Workbenches.
• Maintained/updated electrical system through HarnesSYS.
• Released 2D and 3D drawings in Teamcenter.
• Created technical dispositions and worked with technicians in production.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · CATIA · Harness Design

positions.title: V-22 Aerospace Engineer
positions.description:
• Software/Data Lead - parsed aircraft/fault data for diagnostic and troubleshooting with Built-In Test (BIT) codes.
• Updated/created/maintained aircraft maintenance and repair manuals through discrepancy reports relating to Flight Controls actuators and hydraulic components.
• Collaborated with OEMs through Engineering Investigations (EIs), Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP), and sustainment projects.

positions.title: V-22 Rotors Aerospace Engineer (Rotation)
positions.description:
•	Conducted an Engineering Investigation (EI) with Bell Helicopter at Fort Worth, TX to investigate the delamination of a V-22 Yoke. Performed hub disassembly to expose yoke for Non-Destructive Inspection (NDI) before sanding down paint to composite layers for root cause analysis and future Yoke redesigns/corrective actions.
•	Worked with the Marines on tearing down a V-22 Hub to create maintenance procedures on the proper type of grease to increase component efficiency and prevent aircraft failures.
•	Shadowed Rotors Blade Subject Experts performing Blade EIs on spar cracks at tip light. Performed blade sectioning to examine propagated crack using NDI methods such as X-Ray and Fluorescent Penetrant to determine root cause/consequences and to observe crack.
•	Wrote up instructions for composite repairs of Leading-Edge Grip Fairings in response to fleet’s Technical Assistance Requests (TARs) and increased mission readiness.

positions.title: Vounteered Robotics Mentor
positions.description:
• Mentored/advised students with robotics design, programming, and project management for First Lego League competition.
• Introduced students to Python.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
• Taught and explained mathematical concepts to students.
• Graded practice exams.
• Provided and went over homework.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed simulations of combustion using Paraview and Python script.
• Derived velocity to trace flame from provided pressure and temperature.
• Generated GIFs to show moving flame in the combustion chamber.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: • Literary critics/analysis of ice ingestion on engine performance.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Scripted Matlab Code to perform Mean Line Analysis.
• Researched Mean Line Analysis.

positions.title: Calculus II and III Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Held recitations/office hours.
• Graded tests/homework for Calculus II and III.
• Managed students at the dorm.
• Organized group activities for students as Cluster Leader.

company.name: MIT Office of Engineering Outreach Programs

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
• Completed academic courses in Calculus II, Physics II, Humanities (Most Improved Awards), Chemistry, and Electronics.
• Built a game, PokeMITES, from scratch by soldering LEDs, wires, photosensors, resistors, etc. onto a circuit board, running off of a breadboard connected to a BeagleBone. Developed game logic in Python.
